envelope.description: Complete terminal-owned installation and installed TUI handoff

body.title: Complete terminal-owned installation and installed TUI handoff
body.summary: Compose canonical scripts, private runtime, bundle preparation and required peer ports into the interactive terminal installer. Publish the installed launcher selecting a complete immutable manager/runtime pair and perform the ready-to-TUI foreground handoff.
acceptanceChecks: TTY stdin/stdout/stderr own mode/source selection, exact dependency consent, progress/errors and recommendations; never accept IDE-filled consent or a direct IDE install request.
Only validated exact-ready completion may commit ready, release mutation lock and start installed TUI in the same terminal using private runtime; TUI exit leaves daemon running and returns shell.
Failure/cancel never launches TUI; post-success TUI launch error retains completed install and prints the exact retry command without reinstall/rollback.

Cross-window busy/duplicate/terminal-close cases preserve one operation and no automatic relaunch. Keep source scripts/insrc distinct from the installed launcher and keep the host v2 daemon untouched.
Dev selection only captures validated delivery and requires the s2 adapter; absent dev/dependency/lifecycle/migration capability fails explicitly without invented sibling behavior.
After all s1 entrypoints land, assemble/probe the actual complete payload through t4 tooling. Fixture results remain labeled and no production E2E/install or unqualified-platform success is inferred.

tests.name: terminal installer requires all TTY streams and absent dev adapter fails explicitly
ready commit and lock release precede same terminal installed TUI
cancel install failure and post install TUI error preserve correct outcome
assemble actual complete foundation payload only after all entrypoints exist
successor upgrade replaces its owned launcher and preserves ready selection
canonical POSIX terminal script preserves I O and fixture TUI handoff and PowerShell source preserves invocation contract
